title: Water Treatment System in Hemodialysis & Ultrapure Dialysate Masterclass
description: RO, Deionization, Carbon Filters, Water Softener、AAMI/ISO 水質標準與 Endotoxin/Chloramine 毒性之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Pre-treatment Sequence & Membrane Function (Softener, Carbon Filters, RO)
sections.content:
### 1. Water Treatment Component Sequence Matrix

| Component | Primary Mechanism | Target Contaminant Removed | Essential Monitoring Parameter | Consequence of Component Failure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Multi-Media Depth Filter | Mechanical Filtration | Suspended Particles & Turbidity (> 10-50 microns) |SDI & Pressure Drop (ΔP) | Fouling & Clogging of Downstream Membranes |
| Water Softener | Ion-Exchange Resin (Replaces Ca2+/Mg2+ with Na+) | Hardness Ions (Calcium & Magnesium) | Water Hardness (< 1 grain/gallon or 17.1 mg/L) | Scaling &RO Membrane |
|In-Series | Chemical Adsorption | Free Chlorine & Chloramines | Total Chlorine Test (< 0.1 mg/L) sampled between Worker & Polisher Tanks | Acute Hemolytic Anemia & Methemoglobinemia due to Chloramines |
|RO Unit | Semi-Permeable Membrane under High Hydraulic Pressure | Dissolved Inorganic Salts, Microorganisms, & Pyrogens (95–99% Rejection) | Percent Rejection & Product Water Conductivity / Resistivity | Exposure to Toxic Heavy Metals, Electrolytes, and Bacteria |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Parameter |RO |DI |UF Membrane |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Removal Target | Dissolved Ions, Microorganisms, & Pyrogens | Dissolved Ionic Species Only | Endotoxins, Bacteria, & Pyrogens |
| Effect on Bacteria / Endotoxins | Removes > 99% | Does NOT remove Bacteria; Can Become Bacterial Reservoir | Removes Endotoxins &Produces Ultrapure Water |
| Exhaustion Risk | Gradual Membrane Fouling | Sudden Exhaustion Releasing Concentrated Toxic Contaminants (Fluoride, Copper) | Gradual Transmembrane Pressure Rise |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Municipal Water ➔Removes Sediment ➔Removes Calcium/Magnesium ➔Adsorbs Chloramines ➔ Reverse Osmosis Unit (Removes 99% Ions & Bacteria) ➔Ultrafilter ➔ Ultrapure Dialysate (< 0.1 CFU/mL, < 0.03 EU/mL).

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 採樣測試 Total Chlorine 時，Polisher Tank 後方採樣。
**Analysis**: Worker Tank Polisher Tank 之間的採樣埠採樣！第一道 Carbon Tank 一旦突破 (Breakthrough > 0.1 mg/L)，第二道 Tank 能提供緩衝防護，此時必須立即更換第一道 Tank，否則 Chloramine Hemolytic Anemia。

sections.title: Module 2: Microbiological Standards & Chemical Toxicity Profiles (Chloramine, Fluoride, Aluminum, Endotoxin)
sections.content:
### 1.AAMI / ISO

| Fluid Category |CFU/mL |EU/mL | Action Level Bacterial Count | Action Level Endotoxin |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Standard Dialysis Water | < 100 CFU/mL | < 0.25 EU/mL | 50 CFU/mL | 0.125 EU/mL |
| Ultrapure Dialysate | < 0.1 CFU/mL | < 0.03 EU/mL | 0.05 CFU/mL | 0.015 EU/mL |
| Online Prepared Substitution Fluid | Sterile & Pyrogen-Free | Undetectable (< 0.03 EU/mL) | N/A | N/A |

### 2. Chemical Contaminant Toxicity Profile Table

| Toxic Chemical | Source / Mechanism of Exposure | Pathophysiological Manifestation | Clinical Presentation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Chloramines / Free Chlorine | Municipal Water Disinfectant; Carbon Tank Breakthrough |G6PD/Glutathione | Acute Hemolytic Anemia, Methemoglobinemia, Cyanosis |
| Aluminum | Flocculant in Municipal Water; RO Failure | Bone Deposition & Inhibition of Hydroxyapatite / Disruption of Transferrin | Dialysis Encephalopathy, Fracturing Osteomalacia, Microcytic Anemia |
| Fluoride | Water Fluoridation; Deionizer Exhaustion | Inhibition of Glycolysis & Calcium Complexation | Severe Acute Hypocalcemia, Intractable Ventricular Arrhythmias, Death |
| Copper / Zinc | Copper/Brass Piping Leaching | Direct Red Blood Cell Membrane Lysis & Hepatic Damage | Severe Hemolysis, Abdominal Pain, Severe Vomiting |
|LPS | Biofilm in RO Piping System | Monocyte Activation ➔ IL-1, IL-6, TNF-alpha Release | Pyrogenic Reactions, Fever, Chills, Chronic Microinflammation |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Biofilm Formation in HD Distribution Piping ➔ Release of Endotoxin &Backfiltration / Backdiffusion ➔ Stimulation of Circulating Monocytes ➔ Pro-inflammatory Cytokine Cascade (IL-1, TNF-alpha) ➔ Acute Pyrogenic Reaction (Fever, Chills, Hypotension) & Accelerated Cardiovascular Atherosclerosis.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為只有細菌能夠通過透析膜引發發炎反應，化學毒素與碎片不會影響透析患者。
**Analysis**: 細菌細胞壁碎片、Endotoxins, LPS 與小分子溶質（如 Chloramine, Aluminum, Fluoride）均能透過 Backdiffusion 或透析膜微孔進入患者血液。Microinflammation 與 Microcytic Anemia 治療阻抗；化學毒素更能造成致死性溶血與心律不整。必須堅持定期次氯酸/Heat/Chemical Disinfection 與 Ultrapure 水質標準。
